name: Epic Games Launcher (Windows client)
summary: The Windows Epic launcher is not supported on Lindos; your Epic games work through Heroic (native launcher + Proton).
notes:
Lindos does not set up the Windows Epic Games Launcher through Wine. It can be forced to install (Lutris ships a script) but the result is poor: the store/library pages are web views that render blank or very slowly, it eats CPU while idle, logins break after its frequent self-updates, and games it installs still need Proton anyway. We mark it 'broken' so you do not waste time on it.
Use Heroic Games Launcher instead - a native Linux app that signs in to your Epic (and GOG / Amazon) account, shows your library, downloads the games and runs them with Proton-GE, including cloud saves and the free weekly games: 'lindos-game install heroic' (or Lindos Settings > Gaming > Heroic). Legendary (the command-line tool behind Heroic) is another option.
Anti-cheat note: Epic games work when the developer enabled Easy Anti-Cheat / BattlEye for Linux (Proton). Fortnite is NOT one of them - Epic disabled EAC-Linux for Fortnite, so Fortnite does not run on Lindos or any Linux; see docs/COMPATIBILITY.md and areweanticheatyet.com.

alternatives.name: Heroic Games Launcher
alternatives.how: native Epic/GOG/Amazon client with Proton-GE: lindos-game install heroic (Lindos Settings > Gaming)

alternatives.name: Legendary (CLI)
alternatives.how: command-line Epic client used by Heroic: pip install legendary-gl or the GitHub release

alternatives.name: Lutris
alternatives.how: generic launcher with community install scripts (Epic Games Store script exists but is unsupported): lindos-game install lutris
